independence.method: independent visual-review window followed by deterministic alpha-pixel bounding-box extraction
independence.coordinate_convention: inclusive source-pixel bounds; center offsets are relative to ((width-1)/2, (height-1)/2)

1.rationale: Short straight-sided vessel with a broad cylindrical rim and thick bottom; the lemon and straw are outside the container body.

2.rationale: Short straight-sided red vessel with a broad rim and thick base; the cherry/straw decoration is excluded.

3.rationale: Tall rectangular cylindrical glass with long parallel sides and a narrow base; mint and lime garnish are excluded.

4.rationale: Conical bowl on a narrow stem and foot; flowers and fruit around the rim are not part of the container body.

5.rationale: Rounded bowl tapering into a short stem and foot; pineapple, citrus, flower and straw decorations are excluded.

6.rationale: Wide conical bowl, narrow stem and foot; the cherry, flower and straw are decorative extremes.

7.rationale: Very tall straight-sided cylindrical glass with a thick lower base; orange slice, leaves and straw are excluded.

8.rationale: Rounded blue bowl narrowing into a stem and foot; flower, leaves, citrus and straw are excluded.

9.rationale: Rounded coconut shell container with a broad curved body and flat lower contact region; leaves, flower and straw are excluded.

10.rationale: Rounded pink bowl with a narrow stem and wide foot; hibiscus, fruit and straw are excluded.

11.rationale: Tall straight-sided red highball with a thick transparent base; cherry, citrus and straw are excluded.

12.rationale: Pineapple-shaped vessel with a broad textured body and tapered top; leaves and straw are excluded.

levels.transparent_garnish_exclusion: The review window excludes visible garnish/straw regions; final bounds are the alpha-positive pixels within that independently selected body window.
levels.ambiguity_notes: Semi-transparent glass highlights and rim pixels are retained when alpha >= 32; decorative pixels outside the review window are excluded.
levels.shape_rationale: Short straight-sided vessel with a broad cylindrical rim and thick bottom; the lemon and straw are outside the container body.
